args.code:
# Define external people and systems
client = C4Person(name="Client", description="External energy
user/operator")

with C4SystemBoundary("PSE"):
    pse_wire = C4Container(name="WIRE", description="Grid control component")
    pse_sowe = C4Container(name="SOWE", description="Grid optimization component")
    pse_lfc = C4Container(name="LFC", description="Automatic frequency control")

with C4SystemBoundary("Client Systems"):
    scada = C4Container(name="SCADA", description="Supervisory control")

with C4SystemBoundary("TT apps"):
    tt_lux = C4Container(name="LuxPlanner", description="Planning and optimization")
    tt_wire = C4Container(name="WIRE (TT)", description="Wire calculation tool")
    tt_sowe = C4Container(name="SOWE (TT)", description="Secondary optimization")
    tt_energy = C4Container(name="EnergyLink", description="Data link app")
    tt_kafka = C4Container(name="Kafka", description="Event/message bus")

with C4SystemBoundary("AXPO"):
    bess = C4Container(name="BESS", description="Battery storage software")
    resopt = C4Container(name="ResOpt", description="Resource optimization tool")
    algo = C4Container(name="Algo", description="Negotiation/Algo service")

with C4SystemBoundary("Spectral"):
    stellar = C4Container(name="Stellar", description="Spectral control software")

# Inter-system relationships
pse_lfc >> C4Relationship("activations") >> scada

# TT apps to PSE connections
[tt_lux, tt_wire] >> C4Relationship("links") >> pse_wire
tt_sowe >> C4Relationship("links") >> pse_sowe

# AXPO and TT apps relationships
bess >> C4Relationship("connects") >> tt_lux
bess >> C4Relationship("connects") >> tt_wire
bess >> C4Relationship("connects") >> tt_sowe
bess >> C4Relationship("polling") >> tt_kafka
tt_energy >> C4Relationship("sends data") >> tt_kafka

# AXPO logic: optimize, negotiate
bess >> C4Relationship("requests optimisation") >> resopt
bess >> C4Relationship("negotiates") >> algo

# EnergyLink client access
client >> C4Relationship("connects") >> tt_energy

# Spectral relationships
bess >> C4Relationship("request/receive data") >> stellar
stellar >> C4Relationship("sends data") >> scada
scada >> C4Relationship("SoC data") >> stellar
